## Controls

Updated 3 minutes ago

[View all](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls)

[**Infrastructure security**](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#infrastructure-security)

- Unique production database authentication enforced

- Encryption key access restricted

- Unique account authentication enforced


[View 8 more Infrastructure security controls](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#infrastructure-security)

[**Organizational security**](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#organizational-security)

- Anti-malware technology utilized

- Password policy enforced

- MDM system utilized


[**Product security**](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#product-security)

- Data encryption utilized

- Control self-assessments conducted

- Data transmission encrypted


[**Internal security procedures**](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#internal-security-procedures)

- Risk management program established


[**Data and privacy**](https://trust.mimica.ai/controls#data-and-privacy)

- Data retention procedures established

- Data classification policy established
